source_title: EA Reportedly Asked BioWare to Remove LGBTQ Flag From Mass Effect
source_excerpt:
A new report suggests that EA asked BioWare to remove any depictions of the LGBTQIA+ flag from the canceled Mass Effect Universe , claiming it was meant to avoid offending anyone. The cancellation of the Mass Effect game was part of the recent fallout from BioWare 's closure.
BioWare revealed on October 21 that the studio is officially set to close, more than three decades after the Edmonton-based studio was founded. BioWare has produced a wealth of popular franchises throughout its history, including a variety of licensed games and original series, such as Mass Effect and Dragon Age . The studio also confirmed that the "next Mass Effect project" is being shelved early into its development. Now, former BioWare employees are sharing internal issues with EA's new management.
BioWare Asked to Remove LGBTQIA+ Flag from Mass Effect Universe
As reported by French publication BFM , multiple former BioWare employees confirmed they had been asked to remove the LGBQTIA+ flag from Mass Effect Universe . Multiple anonymous former employees said that when they presented video proposals to EA's new management, the managers were seemingly "not convinced" by their presentation. One presenter said that EA asked them to remove an in-game flag that was similar to the LGBTQIA+ flag, so as "not to offend anyone." The former employee also suggested that BioWare's inclusive stories and romances may have been another reason for EA's new management objective to certain elements of the game.

The fallout from the cancellation of Mass Effect Universe has elicited significant backlash from fans of the franchise. A campaign has quickly gained traction with fans begging to save the Mass Effect series, with hundreds of thousands of people signing a petition on Change.org. The fan petition has grown so large that the #SaveMassEffect campaign has appeared in NYC's Times Square , using ad space to encourage more fans to sign the petition and save the Mass Effect franchise. A Canadian politician has even suggested that the government should help the BioWare staff to buy the studio back from EA to stop the closure.

While Mass Effect Universe has been shelved, fans have kept the franchise alive through mod support. Mass Effect: Legendary Edition has been a popular choice for many modders, with several major mods for the Mass Effect trilogy receiving updates throughout 2026, adding everything from new weapons and armor to improving the games' graphics. The Spectre mod for the original Mass Effect also adds a wealth of new planets to the game, including the home systems of the Asari, Turians, and more.
The closure of BioWare comes in the aftermath of massive changes at EA in 2026. The Saudi Arabia Public Investment Fund officially completed its purchase of EA in August , acquiring 93% of EA alongside Silver Lake and Affinity Partners. The purchase of EA marked the second-biggest buyout in the history of the video games industry, with only Microsoft's landmark acquisition of Activision Blizzard surpassing the purchase. BioWare is likely to be the first of a trend of massive changes at EA, as new management properly assumes control of the company.
